understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation match each goal, then step onto every goal cell to complete all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one tile at a time in cardinal directions, with walls blocking movement. Shape modifiers cycle shape, color modifiers cycle color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. A goal requires all three attributes to match simultaneously. Movement consumes stamina, and exhausting stamina costs a life; losing all lives ends the game.
